hero.eyebrow: Halo & Hue · blonding studio, East Austin
hero.title: Blonde, built slowly.
hero.lede: Foilayage, lived-in blondes and bond care from stylists who only do colour. Scroll through one appointment, from consult to the last pass of the round brush.

stages.c: Natural dark blonde, brassy from last summer. We plan bright foilayage around the face and softer lights through the back.
Seven sections, clipped up, so the foils go where we planned and nowhere else.
Lightener with bond builder, painted and folded into foils, finest at the parting so it grows out soft.
Forty minutes, checked at every foil. It passes through yellow on the way: that is normal.
A pearl toner at the bowl cancels the yellow and leaves a clean, bright blonde.
Three centimetres off the dry ends, with face-framing layers to show off the brightest pieces.
Big round brush, bond oil on the ends, and you leave with a glossy, swingy blonde.

shade.title: Start where you are,
shade.sub: Pick your natural shade and the look you want. We will show it on a strand, with about how long it takes and what it costs. Every new client starts with a free consult.
shade.note: New colour clients need a patch test 48 hours before. It takes five minutes and it is free.

menu.title: Two levels,
menu.sub: Our stylists are either Stylists or Master Colorists. Pick one to see what everything costs with them.

items.d: Painted, then foiled for more lift

menu.note: Prices start from shoulder-length hair. Extra-long or thick hair may need extra lightener; we will tell you first.

team.title: Three stylists,
team.sub: Everyone here specialises in blonde. Pick a stylist and they will be waiting in the booking.

people.spec: Owner and master colorist. Foilayage and blonde corrections.
Glosses, cuts and blowouts. Great with curls.

book.title: Pick your chair,
book.sub: Choose a service, a stylist and a time. We confirm by text with a link for the $40 deposit, which comes off the total.
book.policy: Reschedule free up to 48 hours before. Later than that, the deposit covers the chair.

footer.fine: Halo & Hue Hair Studio is a made-up salon for a concept site.
